How I Work

A Simple Process.
Premium Results.

Every great brand starts with a clear strategy. Our process keeps everything organized, collaborative, and focused so you always know what comes next, from the first conversation to the final delivery.

Start a Project →
Discovery

We start by understanding your business, audience, goals, and competitors. This strategic foundation ensures every design decision supports your brand and business objectives.

What's Included
  • Brand Discovery Session
  • Research & Strategy
Design

With a clear direction established, we transform strategy into impactful visual identity. Every concept is crafted with precision, refined through feedback, and aligned with your brand vision.

What's Included
  • Concept Development
  • Refinement & Revisions
Delivery

After approval, we prepare everything you need to launch with confidence. You'll receive organized, production-ready files and brand assets for both digital and print use.

What's Included
  • Final Brand Assets
  • Brand Guidelines & Support

The Mind Behind The Work
Faihars Bin Iqbal
Brand Designer · Visual Designer

Hi, I'm Faihars — a brand designer passionate about creating visuals that help businesses look premium, build trust, and stand out.

For me, design is never just about making something beautiful. Every logo, advertisement, or identity should communicate a clear message and leave a lasting impression.

I work closely with founders and growing businesses to transform ideas into memorable brands — starting with the business, not the trend.

Whether it's a brand identity from scratch or high-converting marketing creatives, my focus stays on quality, clarity, and impact.
